note: pathway skill ids -> BANK skill ids, same contract as pathway-crosswalk.json. Read by utils/skillCanonicalizer.js buildPathway() for CONTENT LOOKUP ONLY — never by canonicalSkillId (mastery keying). Kept in a SEPARATE file because scripts/proposePathwayCrosswalk.js overwrites pathway-crosswalk.json wholesale; manual rows here win on collision. Filename deliberately does NOT end in '-crosswalk.json' so the canonicalization glob cannot sweep it up. Covers geometry, algebra-2, precalculus, act-prep, algebra-1 and 6th-grade-math.
why: The fuzzy matcher (auditCourseProblemCoverage.js --suggest) is unreliable in geometry: it proposed geometric-mean -> mean (the arithmetic average), trigonometric-ratios-intro -> ratios, and circle-basics -> trig-unit-circle-evaluation. Those would serve a geometry student the wrong topic entirely. The rows below are matched by mathematical MEANING instead. Skills with no honest bank match (points-lines-planes, polygon-angle-sum, quadrilateral-properties, trapezoid-properties, geometric-mean) are deliberately ABSENT — they are real content gaps and must stay visible as such. 2026-08-02: 28 rows added after comparing a full DB export against the generated bank — 21 of 35 skills that the audit reported EMPTY already had content under another name. The audit measures REACHABILITY, not existence: an unmapped skill reads empty whether or not problems exist for it. Always diff against the bank before generating. 2026-08-03 (calculus): AB/BC review skills map to the precalc/trig banks they revise; AB/BC calc skills map to the existing calc bank ids (limits, derivatives, ftc, ...) whose thin families the low-volume templates now top up. The cumulative/AP-practice-mode rows (cumulative-mcq-practice, ap-frq-*, calculator-active-fluency) map MODE to mixed CONTENT — the mode itself is the tutor's job; the rows only give it material to run. 2026-08-03 (early-math + parents): the emf-* prefix is pure vocabulary seam — 24 of 31 skills map onto the elementary banks (rounding 274, compare-numbers 347, the one-step fact/CGI-unknown families, the fraction-operation banks). The parent-course model skills (ten frames, bar models, algebra tiles, chip model, ...) are authored in templatesParentModels.js under their own ids because the MODELS are the content; emf-mental-math-strategies crosswalks to that shared mental-math-strategies family rather than duplicating it. 2026-08-04 (ladder test-outs): the owner's requirement is that no ladder skill denies a test-out for lack of items. The pattern-ladder (skills-unified) ids and the legacy catalog duplicates are mapped here by MEANING onto the content banks; routes/mastery.js now samples challenges across skillLookupCandidates, so these rows are what makes a test-out servable. Matcher traps rejected during review: mode->modeling, regrouping->factoring, ratio-tables->frequency-tables. Calc-3 rows map to the calc3-* family banks; triple/cylindrical map to the nearest family (calc3-double-integrals) deliberately, noted as family-level coverage.
